# AcceptTCPStream <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Network](BlitzBasic-Network)

</div>


```blitzbasic
AcceptTCPStream:Int32 tcp_server:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tcp_server` | In | Int32 | required | The server from [CreateTCPServer](CreateTCPServer). |

**Returns:** A TCP stream, or 0 when nobody connected.

## Description

Takes the next connection that a client made to a TCP server and returns a stream for it. If nobody connected within the accept timeout of [TCPTimeouts](TCPTimeouts), which is 0 until you set it, it returns 0, so call it in a loop.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
TCPTimeouts 1000, 1000
server = CreateTCPServer(40751)
client = OpenTCPStream("127.0.0.1", 40751)
connection = 0
For i = 1 To 50
	connection = AcceptTCPStream(server)
	If connection <> 0 Then Exit
	Delay 20
Next
WriteLine client, "hello server"
Print ReadLine$(connection)
CloseTCPStream client
CloseTCPStream connection
CloseTCPServer server
```

```text
hello server
```
